sylvia: Heads-up: sample Cloudflare Worker using the JS SDK fails with 'Cannot use import statement outside a module' and TS shows client.generate(...) as any/unknown.
noah: Likely export resolution. Which import?
sylvia: `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk'`
isabel: Two problems: bundler picked the CJS require path at resolution time, and the d.ts has overlapping overloads that widen the return to unknown.
noah: Quick checks: package.json "exports" must have an explicit "import" target (esm). Also consider publishing a dedicated ./worker subpath to force ESM for edge runtimes.
isabel: On TS side, change tsconfig.moduleResolution to "bundler" (or node16) for esbuild/wrangler. Example minimal tsconfig for workers: `{ "compilerOptions": { "module": "ESNext", "moduleResolution": "bundler", "target": "ES2021", "allowSyntheticDefaultImports": true, "skipLibCheck": true } }`.
sylvia: Tried that and added a ./worker export locally. Runtime error went away but I still had to add `<T>` at one call site to get full typed shape.
isabel: That indicates the public typings default generic is too wide. We should: 1) prefer a single generic signature like `generate<T = JsonValue>(opts): Promise<T>` instead of multiple overlapping overloads; 2) avoid fallback overloads returning any/unknown; 3) consider default generic = JsonValue (or Record<string, unknown>) so callers get usable inference without annotating.
noah: Also add a small compat d.ts for older TS versions and consider typesVersions in package.json so TS resolves better across toolchains.
sylvia: I'll open issues: (a) add ./worker export, (b) typings overload cleanup, (c) sample-app README note with tsconfig snippet.
pkg-bot: Created issue #900 for worker export, #901 for typings cleanup.
isabel: Nice. For immediate onboarding notes: "Edge workers: if you see import errors, set moduleResolution: "bundler" and import the worker subpath (e.g., '@redwood-inference/sdk/worker') if available. If types collapse to any, annotate generics or upgrade to the patched SDK."
sylvia: Thanks everyone, unblocked demo. :thumbsup:
